<reason>PRO kept a live path that CON never neutralized: return without capacity preserves the theft's second half, and a recipient-directed, finite endowment can be duty-based without control. CON's central dilemma - aid vs boardroom colonialism - was answered by duty-why-pay vs control-what-to-command and who-decides in Lagos, while CON's ship-apologize-silence left deterioration and survival unanswered and relied on asserting no third option exists. Clipped opening added execution cost to CON.</reason>
